name: tutor_application_review
description: Administrator-controlled tutor application decision, comments, history, certificate verification and email queue state

tutor_email.description: Tutor email derived from the profile owner for owner-scoped status reads

status.description: Administrator-controlled review status; never stored in the tutor-editable profile

latest_comment.description: Latest administrator comment visible to the tutor

reviewed_revision.description: Application revision last opened or decided by an administrator

reviewed_profile_updated_at.description: Tutor profile built-in updated_at captured when an administrator opens or reopens the application

reviewed_snapshot_json.description: Bounded JSON snapshot of non-file application fields for this review

verified_document_ids.description: Certificate document ids verified by an administrator

decision_history_json.description: Append-only demo history of administrator status decisions and comments

notification_state.description: Transactional decision-email state; sent means accepted by the email integration

notification_error_code.description: Safe error code when a transactional email remains queued

notification_updated_at.description: Timestamp of the most recent email attempt
